page.layout: One printed page: digitiser's cover sheet with e-rara logo, title block, and licence notices; no running text. Nothing transcribed as main text.
page.notes: Cover sheet of the digitiser (e-rara.ch, Bibliothèque de Genève, Visual Library logo, shelf mark and persistent link, multilingual terms of use). Per the rules, the digitiser's banner, logo, links and cover text are left out. The bibliographic record it shows reads: Amport, Christian, "Ad Sebastiani Verronis Friburgensium apud Helvetios parochi ac sacerdotis Jesuastri, quaestiones de Verbo Dei, S. Scriptura comprehenso, Responsiones analyticae et <anaskeuastikai>. Per Christianum ...", Genève, 1586, Shelf Mark Bc 191. This is not printed text of the book's own pages and is not transcribed.
